title: Delhi HC Revives Patent Plea: Refusal Can't Rest on a Ground Never Put to the Applicant
case_name: Glisten LLC v. Assistant Controller of Patents & Designs
card_summary: Justice Purushaindra Kumar Kaurav set aside the Patent Office's refusal of Glisten LLC's application for a gemstone coating invention. The Controller had rejected claims 1 to 17 for lack of inventive step, but the hearing notice never said that objection still applied to those claims. The court held this breached Section 14 and natural justice, and sent the application back for fresh consideration.
card_tip: Check that a hearing notice states every ground against every claim it covers; a refusal built on an unstated ground can fall on that basis alone, whatever the merits.
verification_notes: Cross-verified against LiveLaw Biz and SupremeToday.ai, both reporting the same bench, case number, date and outcome; no primary order text located.
